description: Normalized financial statements of US-listed companies straight from SEC XBRL filings (10-K/10-Q): revenue, gross profit, operating and net income, EPS, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, operating cash flow, capex, free cash flow, net margin, long-term debt. Annual or quarterly, up to 20 years, by ticker or CIK. One clean row per period instead of thousands of raw XBRL facts. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.005 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/company-financials.

ticker.description: US ticker, e.g. AAPL (or company name)
